name: fusion-vision-mcp
description: An MCP server fusing Florence-2, Moondream2, SAM2 and CLIP for image captioning, OCR, object detection/grounding, visual question answering, spatial measurement and aesthetic scoring

memory_mode.title: Memory mode
memory_mode.description: How long the vision models stay in memory after their last use, trading memory against speed. "aggressive" releases them after 5 minutes idle (lowest memory). "standard" releases them after 10 minutes. "persistent" never releases them (fastest, highest memory). You can also enter a number of minutes, such as 30. Models always reload automatically on the next request, so no setting can lose work -- only time.

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Transcribe dense printed text from an image or PDF. Use query_image instead for watermarks, logos and stylized text.

tools.name: caption
tools.description: Describe what an image shows, as one detailed prose caption of the whole scene.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Locate a named object in an image, returning bounding boxes, center points and labels.

tools.name: dense_region_caption
tools.description: Caption every salient region of an image at once, with bounding boxes, without naming objects first.

tools.name: query_image
tools.description: Ask a free-form question about an image (visual question answering), backed by Moondream2.

tools.name: batch_analyze_images
tools.description: Run one operation across many images in a single call, isolating failures per image.

tools.name: spatial_relations
tools.description: Measure contact, gaps, containment depth and shape between named objects using SAM2 masks.

tools.name: score_aesthetics
tools.description: Rate how aesthetically pleasing an image looks on a 1-10 scale, using the CLIP/LAION predictor.

tools.name: critique_composition
tools.description: Critique an image's framing against the rule of thirds and explain, for low-scoring shots, what looks off.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Run a raw Florence-2 task token against an image, for tasks the named tools do not cover.
